title: Derive the local kernel pin from YEROKET_ROOT instead of duplicating a full SHA
body: The first VIXEN configure failed because -DVIXEN_YEROKET_KERNEL_SHA_OVERRIDE repeated a mistyped full commit even though YEROKET_ROOT already identified the lane checkout. The working recovery was git rev-parse HEAD followed by a second queued configure. VixenKernelSnapshot should resolve and record HEAD from the validated local root, or accept HEAD directly, so local-provider selection cannot disagree with its pin.

title: Publish the queued targeted CodegenTool test project entrypoint
body: The first queued targeted build used Packages/com.yeroket.utility.kernel-framework/CodegenTool~/CodegenTool.Tests/CodegenTool.Tests.csproj and failed MSB1009; repository discovery showed the actual path is CodegenTool~/Tests/CodegenTool.Tests.csproj. A documented wrapper or affected-tests entrypoint should own this path so lanes do not manually reconstruct it.

title: Keep worker SPT proposal examples synchronized with required routing tags
body: The lane brief's documented propose command failed first for a missing tier tag and then for a missing effort tag. The working command added --tag tier:sol and --tag effort:S. The generated worker rules or CLI error should supply a complete accepted example so every lane does not discover the routing contract through retries.
